```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(palmerpenguins))
```

```{r}
penguins_clean <- penguins %>%
  drop_na()

# Beautiful graphic with data source, title, and ordered legends
ggplot(penguins_clean, aes(x = flipper_length_mm, y = body_mass_g,
                           color = species, shape = sex)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 3) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  labs(
    title = "Data from the palmerpenguins package",
    x = "Flipper Length (mm)",
    y = "Body Mass (g)",
    color = "Species",
    shape = "Sex",
    caption = "Palmer Station Long-Term Ecological Research (LTER) Program"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.box = "vertical",        # Stack legends vertically
    legend.box.just = "left",       # Align box to the left side of legend area
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 1, face = "italic", size = 10)
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(order = 1),
    shape = guide_legend(order = 2)
  )
```
